name: Mangetsu no Yoru ni wa Goyoujin
source:
You were looking for a place to move into after getting a job in a new area.

You were introduced to a strange share house by a realty agency that you happened to stop by.

There you meet the four mysterious residents: Shin Kamiya, Mao Nekomiya, Hyouko Suzuki and Tasuku Ichinose.

All of them are good looking men, but have an mysterious aura surrounding them…

What is their true identity? And what will come of your fate after choosing to live in this peculiar share house?

[from [url=http://www.englishotomegames.net/post/134906202871/mystrangelovers]English Otome Game[/url]]
